summary.text: Derek Mallow, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2022 and represents Senate District 2, which includes Savannah, Garden City, Port Wentworth and part of Thunderbolt.

paragraphs.text: Before that Mallow represented House District 163 in Chatham County, beginning in 2020.

A native of Savannah, Mallow earned degrees from Asbury University and a Master of Public Administration from Savannah State University, and is executive director and CEO of the nonprofit East Savannah United.
